description.en: A traditional Chinese medicine agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: bundles nine classical texts with an auto-generated knowledge-base index, runs a structured consultation before prescribing in seven sections (herbal and acupuncture in one prescription, with prescription sheet, rationale and textual cross-check), and archives answers as case records.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的中医经方预设：随包九部经典并自动生成资料库索引，先按寒热、出汗、二便、睡眠、舌象与六部脉动态问诊，再按七段出方（方药与针灸同列处方，附处方笺、方义与条文校证），回答自动归档为医案。
